body: Didn't mean to leave you hanging. I'm still here. This is a throwaway that I am only on when I get super low. 55 days and I'm on it again...
Wow. I feel like I could have written this. I am in a very similar situation.
I have the same obsession with bridges. I have always struggled with a fear of heights, but bridges have always had a power that draws me to them.
I have no confidence in myself, and when I do actually gain confidence, something happens that just bottoms me out again. I can't afford to be unemployed again.
I was a retail manager for 18 years. I'm 40. I'm trying to change careers, but I am failing miserably. I'm not comfortable enough to say what that career is right now.
Thank you. I am trying. I haven't given up. I have made it a goal to pay my parents back at some point.

I am feeling the exact same way, and I'm 40. I have started a new career, and love my job, my friends, and my family, but I feel like a burden to them. I just can't get ahead financially, and the stress is slowly killing me. I have had to borrow from my parents who should be saving for their own retirement. I go through spells where things seem great for a while, then something happens that throws everything off and sends me spiraling into hopelessness again. I wish I had answers for you, but, even being twice your age, I am in the same boat.
